snapshot.extension_policy: source_database_sha256 and source_database_bytes describe only the recovered base snapshot. Versions appended afterwards are declared in authored_extensions with their own input sources; source_version_count and source_system_count cover the whole delivery.
snapshot.provenance_digest_basis: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 provenance JSON stored in the source database
snapshot.redaction_policy: Only absolute workstation source_root/runtime_root values are replaced with consistent local-source:SHA256(value) locators. All source facts, identities, versions and clocks are retained.
